name: redmine
description: Connect Cursor to Redmine with your instance URL and API access key. Fetch projects and tickets, and filter issues by project, status, assignee, tracker, priority, version, saved queries, custom fields, and more.

REDMINE_URL.title: Redmine URL
REDMINE_URL.description: Base URL of your Redmine instance, e.g. https://redmine.example.com (no trailing slash required)

REDMINE_API_KEY.title: API access key
REDMINE_API_KEY.description: API access key from Redmine → My account → API access key. REST API must be enabled by an administrator.

REDMINE_READ_ONLY.title: Read-only mode
REDMINE_READ_ONLY.description: When true (default), only read tools are enabled. Set to false to allow creating and updating issues.
